status: preregistered local pilot, no outcomes inspected at registration
primary_comparison: E versus C, paired same groups
development_timing: One group from each development template (12 records) may be used for speed/compatibility only. Do not tune on test outcomes.
resource_rule: Start on CPU. Finish baseline then B/C/E seeds 17 and 29 if runtime is practical. Record any curtailed run and reason. No paid compute authorized.
limitations: Only 3 test template clusters; uncertainty exploratory.
Pilot arms do not match unique-example diversity.
No RL, external benchmark or second model family.
Small training budgets do not establish converged method performance.
stopping_rule: No outcome-based early stop or example selection. Hardware/software failures may pause a run; document them.
prompt_instruction: Return only the integer answer to the problem. Do not explain. Do not add units or formatting.
amendment: Before test-set evaluation, development-only outputs showed formatting noncompliance and 96-token truncation. Use identical answer-only instruction and integer-only SFT targets for every arm. Keep development diagnostics. No test outcomes inspected.
